item.title: About TechCheck Solutions
item.description:
Who We Are

TechCheck Solutions is run by Adam — a tech enthusiast and IT professional based in Whitby, Ontario with years of hands-on experience in PC repair, networking, and web development.

After working in enterprise IT and running his own repair business, Adam started TechCheck Solutions to bring practical, no-nonsense tech help to everyday people and small businesses in the Durham Region and beyond.

item.title: Services
item.description:
PC Repair & Tune-Ups

Is your PC running slow, crashing, or just not performing like it used to? We offer fast, affordable repair and maintenance services to get you back up and running.

  • Virus and malware removal
  • Performance tune-ups and optimization
  • Hardware diagnostics and repair
  • RAM, SSD, and component upgrades
  • Thermal paste replacement and cleaning
  • Windows reinstallation and data backup

Web Design for Small Businesses

Need a professional website that actually brings in customers? We build clean, fast, modern websites for small businesses — no bloated page builders, no monthly fees to us.
